name: @openseas/studio-server
description: The puzzle studio's service (ADR 0042, ADR 0043): tester links, the owner's sign-in, the owner's drafts (ADR 0045) Save for a draft's numbers and picks (ADR 0046, ADR 0053), the chat: an agent on the draft's worktree (ADR 0047), and the takes it makes, kept in a bucket (ADR 0051). Deals no round and knows nothing of the game's accounts.
